identitySignals: millsscholars.org describes Mills Teacher Scholars as a teacher-led inquiry professional-learning program and mentions collaboration with Oakland Unified School District teachers, matching OUSD's classroom and academic programs contracts

Lead by Learning (weleadbylearning.org), based at 5000 MacArthur Boulevard, Oakland, CA, quotes the 'executive director of Mills Teacher Scholars' and works with OUSD, but no cited page states the legal relationship to Mills Teacher Scholars or Mills College
research.notes: Legal entity is unclear. Mills Teacher Scholars appears to have been a program of Mills College (EIN 94-1156566 on ProPublica), which later became part of Northeastern University; the program now appears to operate as Lead by Learning (weleadbylearning.org, 5000 MacArthur Blvd, Oakland, info-leadbylearning@northeastern.edu). No cited page confirms the legal relationship, so legal name, org type, website and contact details were left null. Needs human review.

profile.summary: Mills Teacher Scholars is an Oakland-based program that supports teacher-led inquiry. Teachers study their students' learning and work together to improve their teaching. It works with school partners, including Oakland Unified School District teachers.
